evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically during growth from 3.02 to 3.49 Torr (k=20->26) while Ar setpoint/flow held at 100 sccm
Flow steady at ~99-100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from increased gas input
Exhaust O2 stays low (4-6 ppm), arguing against an air in-leak
Thermocouple tracks 750 °C setpoint with plausible heater power (~46%)

args.missing_evidence: Reference mean/sd for pressure during growth, and a flow-step or pump/valve check to confirm rising downstream restriction rather than normal precursor outgassing
